subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Which of the following statement is not true?
 (a)
The sum of two even function is even.
(b)
The sum of two odd function is odd.
(c)
The sum of an even function and an odd function
is odd.
(d)
The sum of an even function and an odd function
is neither even nor odd.

options.text: The sum of two even function is even.
The sum of two odd function is odd.
The sum of an even function and an odd function
The sum of an even function and an odd function

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-05 (Signal and Systems).
